statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-115539 (GHSA-628g-hv7f-pgjc) is in SwarmKit's Cluster-API proxy, which Docker Engine vendors: WithMetadataForwardTLSInfo discards the redirect guard's changes, so during a short window after a leader change a holder of a worker node certificate can obtain a manager node certificate (https://github.com/moby/swarmkit/security/advisories/GHSA-628g-hv7f-pgjc). SwarmKit v2.1.3 fixes it (commit a34f01e, "ca: forward a request to the leader only once", https://github.com/moby/swarmkit/commit/a34f01e8c294ace05ffbfc2aef669f8fb8b7e8d5), and Docker Engine 29.9.3 moves to it: its release notes list CVE-2026-115539 under the SwarmKit update (https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.9.3), and its go.mod requires github.com/moby/swarmkit/v2 v2.1.3, where 29.9.2 required an earlier pre-release of it. The vulnerable code is in dockerd, shipped in docker-engine. Read /usr/bin/dockerd in every published docker-engine build for Alpine 3.24, 29.5.2-r0 to 29.10.0-r0, x86_64 and aarch64: its Go build information records swarmkit v2.1.2 or a v2.1.3 pre-release up to 29.9.2-r2 and v2.1.3 from 29.9.2-r3 on, and the refusal the fix adds ("more than one redirect to leader: request was already forwarded") is absent up to 29.9.2-r2 and present in 29.9.2-r3 and every later build. 29.9.2-r3 is Docker Engine 29.9.2 rebuilt with SwarmKit v2.1.3, so the range ends there, at the first fixed build; 29.9.3-r0 to 29.9.3-r4 and 29.10.0-r0 are Docker Engine 29.9.3 and 29.10.0.
